title: Where the Snow Is Kept
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
After a long and hard, hard time,
God spoke down from on high;
He didn't scold, but showed him all
the snow, the sea, the sky.

[Chorus]
Look at the stars, the mountains tall,
the tiny ladybug;
God made it all, so great and wise,
and keeps you safe and snug.

[Verse 2]
"Did you hang up the twinkling stars?
Or make the great big sea?"
Job's eyes grew wide at all God made,
how great, how wise was He!

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my little one,
the stars are shining bright;
The God who made them, big and wise,
is near you through the night.

[Chorus]
mood: Wonder music. A wide, slow swell rises and falls under the voice, as if the whole sky were breathing over the stars, the snow, and the sea. The first two verses keep that open, lifting sway as Job's eyes grow big with wonder. By the last verse the swell sinks lower and slower, drawing the great big sky down into one small, safe room.
